name: MARIA  (ANNA MARIA) MALETTA
bioAdditions: Anna Maria was born on 25 May 1692, daughter of Ferdinando Maletta and Isabella Moraca (S1). She married Antonio Villella on 24 July 1713 (S2) and was buried as a widow on 10 January 1762 (S3).
